title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 6: B1+ → B2 GATEWAY

targets.active_vocabulary: 1600+ words, collocations, phrasal verbs, idiomatic chunks and academic expressions
targets.skills: integrated B1+ communication with a structured bridge into B2 accuracy, complexity, fluency and independence

grammar_focus: past deduction: must have, might have, could have, can't have
third conditional and mixed conditional awareness
complex sentence structure and clause reduction
discourse markers, cohesion and paragraph development
hedging and cautious language for B2 communication

missions.title: B1+ Vocabulary Expansion Lab
missions.focus: collocations, phrasal verbs, word families, idiomatic chunks and academic vocabulary
missions.output: Use 45–55 target items accurately in connected speech and writing

missions.title: Future Timeline Command
missions.focus: future continuous, future perfect, predictions and planned events
missions.output: Describe complex future timelines and explain form choices

missions.title: Past Deduction Investigation
missions.focus: must have, might have, could have and can't have
missions.output: Reconstruct an unknown event from evidence and competing possibilities

missions.title: Conditional Decision Lab
missions.focus: third conditional and mixed hypothetical situations
missions.output: Discuss alternative past outcomes and present consequences

missions.title: Modal Precision & Hedging
missions.focus: certainty, probability, obligation, criticism and cautious claims
missions.output: Express nuanced opinions without overclaiming

missions.title: Relative Clause Upgrade
missions.focus: defining and non-defining relative clauses and sentence compression
missions.output: Transform basic sentences into precise information-rich statements

missions.title: Reporting & Passive Information
missions.focus: reporting verbs, passive voice and reported speech
missions.output: Summarize announcements, interviews and information accurately

missions.title: Verb Pattern Mastery
missions.focus: gerunds, infinitives and common verb-pattern contrasts
missions.output: Use complex verb patterns naturally in conversation and writing

missions.title: Complex Sentence Architecture
missions.focus: subordination, coordination, participle clauses and cohesion
missions.output: Build a coherent B1+/B2-style paragraph from short ideas

missions.title: B2 Gateway Discussion Lab
missions.focus: turn-taking, follow-up questions, clarification, agreement and disagreement
missions.output: Sustain a 12–15 minute discussion with limited scripted support

missions.title: Reading Mastery — Evidence & Inference
missions.focus: main argument, supporting evidence, inference, writer purpose and vocabulary in context
missions.output: Read 1100–1300 words and justify interpretations with textual evidence

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Natural Voices
missions.focus: connected speech, attitude, implication, speaker intention and multiple viewpoints
missions.output: Complete detailed and inferential tasks from 11–13 minutes of audio

missions.title: B2 Gateway Writing — Opinion & Argument
missions.focus: thesis, reasons, examples, counterarguments, cohesion and conclusion
missions.output: Write 300–380 words with a clear, logically developed argument

missions.title: Formal Communication Lab
missions.focus: formal emails, requests, complaints, proposals and register control
missions.output: Write and revise professional communication for different audiences

missions.title: Real-World Challenge — Travel & Services
missions.focus: disruption, complaints, alternatives, negotiation and polite escalation
missions.output: Resolve a multi-stage service problem using flexible language

missions.title: Health, Community & Emergency Simulation
missions.focus: explaining situations, interpreting instructions and requesting appropriate help
missions.output: Handle complex health, public-service and safety scenarios

missions.title: Study, Work & Technology Communication
missions.focus: meetings, deadlines, digital communication, presentations and collaborative problem solving
missions.output: Participate in a simulated professional or academic communication cycle

missions.title: Independent Problem-Solving Quest
missions.focus: negotiation, alternatives, compromise, justification and decision-making
missions.output: Solve five connected problems while defending choices in English

missions.title: B1+ → B2 Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: advanced vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing under time pressure
missions.output: Complete a full gateway assessment across all core skills

missions.title: WORLD 6 MASTER QUEST — B2 GATEWAY
missions.focus: final transition from independent B1+ communication toward B2 performance
missions.output: Complete advanced reading, natural listening, extended discussion, formal writing, presentation and real-world simulation

assessment.accuracy: strong B1+ grammar control with emerging B2 complexity
assessment.fluency: sustained independent communication with natural turn-taking
assessment.comprehension: main ideas, details, inference, attitude and implied meaning
assessment.production: organized connected speech and logically developed writing
assessment.independence: communicate flexibly without relying on sentence-by-sentence translation
assessment.b2_gateway: demonstrate readiness for longer, more complex B2-level tasks
